sourceAuthority: Government of Canada / CEIC 2026 EI premium rate and maximum insurable earnings announcement
verificationNote: Expected values are the CRA-PUBLISHED annual EI maxima (outside Quebec). An employee whose insurable earnings exceed MIE ($68,900.00) is capped at these authoritative amounts.

cases.description: Employee earning above MIE: EI employee premium caps at CRA-published maximum.
cases.notes: MIE × rate = 68,900 × 0.0163 = 1,123.07 (matches the CRA-published max exactly).

cases.description: Employer EI caps at CRA-published employer maximum.
cases.notes: MIE × employer rate = 68,900 × 0.02282 = 1,572.298 → CRA rounds to 1,572.30 (the published authoritative value).

cases.description: Per §13 rule: employer EI is looked up from the CRA-published employer rate and maximum — never derived as 1.4 × employee at max.
cases.notes: 1.4 × 1,123.07 = 1,572.298 → 1,572.30. The 1.4 multiplier is metadata; the AUTHORITATIVE value is what CRA publishes.
